project: TRANS-PLANT title menu (ruling 113; MENU-002C1 universal-overlay renderer, APPROVED AND LOCKED; MENU-002H four-background rotation release: Earth, Mars V3, Ringed V2-B and Nebula V1, all APPROVED AND LOCKED; APPROVED FOR RELEASE by the PMO and released to production by MENU-002I, see ../RELEASE_RECORD.txt)

rotation.selection: one equal-probability draw per fresh page load (Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) over the four, in registry order: each an equal quarter), kept for the page session (setup BACK and RECORDS keep it; nothing is redrawn or reloaded); no storage; no player-facing selector; ?view=earth|mars|ringed|nebula forces one, ?view=random draws from the rotation only
rotation.excluded: mars-v1 and ringed-v1 (REJECTED) are QA-only forced views, never drawn, not bundled; source/ringed_v2.png and source/nebula_v1.png (the supplied originals) are not registered and never loaded
rotation.portable_bundle: all four active backgrounds and the overlay (tools/build_portable.js), so every active view composites from disk (file://) in Chrome and Firefox with no network and no two-layer fallback
rotation.station_effects: earth only: the three station navigation lights and NEW GAME's 'Departure authorised. Mind the station.'; mars, ringed and nebula: no lights, 'Departure authorised. Safe travels.'

source.what: Mars V3 (MENU-002C2): Mars V2 with its skylight defect repaired. V2's registration mirrored the 24 rows above the placed painting (rows 0..23, x >= 480) about row 24, which bent the sun's radial rays into a chevron through the upper skylights and mirrored the stars. V3 rebuilds only those rows from the real painting below them: rays continued straight along their own direction from the sun, the nebula pane's glow carried upward, stars transplanted from sky the room hides (no star group on screen twice). Rows 24..1023 and x < 480 are V2 byte for byte; planet, terrain, colours, lighting and sunrise unchanged.
source.status: Mars V3 as APPROVED AND LOCKED (PMO, MENU-002C2); preserved as the source of the runtime file; never loaded
